title: William F. Sharpe — The Arithmetic of Active Management (1991)
use: Value-weighted aggregate active/passive arithmetic and the need for an identified feasible benchmark; higher net active costs are an explicit condition, not a universal empirical claim.
verification: Inspected the full author-hosted article, especially definitions and aggregate argument (retrieved lines 17–30), incomplete universes/weighting/survivorship (35–47), and the ex-ante feasible comparison (48). No historical quotations or numerical examples copied. The chapter derives its own finite ledger and qualifies the cost ordering.

verification: Inspected actual author-hosted full text: THE RATIO, Time Dependence, Related Measures, Scale Independence, and portfolio-correlation discussion (retrieved lines 12–155).
